text: Here's how to act on a first date if you actually want a second one. First, stop trying to impress her. It's not a job interview. It's not please like me. It is I'm here to have fun and you're welcome to join. Second, don't just avoid awkward silences. Add emotions when you speak. Use your face. Use your hands. Use your voice. You are not a robot. Third, avoid serious talk. Keep it fun, playful, and relaxed. Food, travel, dumb stories way better than your hot take on American politics. Fourth, add playful, flirty topics. Besides talking about safe stuff like work, studies, or travel, also add in topics about men and women, dating, nightclubs, how people flirt, etc. Fifth, physical touch. Don't be afraid. Try to get at least one moment where the girl stops you playfully. You need to understand that even if the girl stops you during your attempt, given that it's done appropriately, she still will give you silent approval, because in her eyes, you are the man who can act and who is not afraid of his own wishes.
